title: Nice Throw (Wii Sports)
blurb: 'Nice throw!' — Wii Sports bowling's relentlessly supportive announcer, praising you regardless of the actual result. The Wii-era optimism is unmatched: this man believes in you completely and has never once been discouraging. Play it for genuine successes, or for the ironic joy of being complimented on something that went badly.
origin: The bowling announcer from Wii Sports (Nintendo, 2006).
